A PROPER BESPOKE SERVICE

Established in 1984, MB Picture Framing is a well-established family business specialising in bespoke picture framing. With 38 years of experience, we have built up an enviable reputation in and around Grimsby. As well as being members of the Federation of Small Businesses, we’re also proud to have won the Best Picture Framing Company 2021 at the SME Northern Enterprise Awards.

 

All frames are hand-crafted by the team in our workshop and a range of finishes are available to help you achieve your desired result. Whether we’re framing artwork, photography, embroideries or football shirts, your items are fully covered by our insurance policy. Contact us today to discuss your framing ideas and get a free quote.

FAQS
DO YOU PROVIDE UV PROTECTION FOR ARTWORK?

Yes, we use Art Glass 70.

DO YOU STRETCH EMBROIDERIES?

Yes, we've stretched hundreds over the years. Our experienced team will take great care with your embroidery.

DO YOU FRAME FOOTBALL SHIRTS?

Yes, we do this on a regular basis - framed football shirts make ideal gifts, so get in touch with us so we can take care of it.

DO YOU FRAME LIMITED EDITIONS?

Yes, we do - plus with our full insurance, you can rest assured that your limited edition item is fully covered.

DO YOU FRAME ORIGINAL PAINTINGS?

Yes, we have the skills and expertise to re-frame your original paintings with ease.
